📖 How to use

      
  1. Choose a direction (up, down, left, right).
  2. Set the triangle size and pick a color.
  3. Preview the triangle live.
  4. Click "Copy CSS" and paste the snippet into your stylesheet.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Are the triangles sharp on retina screens?
The triangle is made from a zero-size element with thick borders — it is resolution-independent and stays crisp at any zoom.
Do I need any fallback for old browsers?
For IE11 support, the code works as-is since it uses only classic border properties.
How do I position the triangle in my layout?
The generator emits only the triangle; add margin, float or a wrapper class in your own CSS to position it.
